QF.id: AIFM CII Fund Monitoring Reporting and Exit_20

question.text: Under Regulation 22 of the SEBI (AIF) Regulations, which of the following does the Manager of Kaveri Capital AIF NOT need to disclose to investors?

answer.text: Financial, risk management, operational, portfolio and transactional information on fund investments.
Any inquiries/legal actions by legal or regulatory bodies in any jurisdiction, as and when they occur.
The specific source of every commitment from each LP and the LP's personal tax records.
Any material liability arising during the AIF's tenure, as and when it occurs.

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Regulation 22 requires disclosure of (a) financial/risk/operational/portfolio/transactional info, (b) fees to Manager/Sponsor/associates, (c) inquiries/legal actions, (d) material liabilities, (e) breaches of PPM, (f) change of control of Sponsor/Manager/Investee, (g) significant changes in key investment team, (h) systemic-risk info to SEBI. LP personal tax records are NOT within the disclosure regime. **The Trap:** All other options paraphrase actual Reg 22 items directly. Only the tax-records option is a privacy-law violation distractor. **Cross-Exam Context:** XIX-C tests Regulation 22 identically. XXIV (AML) addresses KYC/tax-status capture at onboarding, which is separate. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Maintain a 'Reg 22 disclosure register' with date-stamped entries whenever any trigger event occurs. In SEBI inspections this register is one of the first artefacts requested — having a blank register implies non-disclosure.
